headline: Chief Minister Issues Formal Clarification After Hand Gesture In Assembly Accidentally Orders 400 Extra Plates Of Biryani
body:
The state’s chief minister clarified today that a vigorous hand gesture made during his impassioned speech in the legislative assembly was intended to signify 'economic growth' rather than a direct instruction to the assembly canteen staff to prepare 400 additional portions of mutton biryani. The misunderstanding occurred midway through his address on fiscal policy, when the minister’s rapid palm-shaking motion was interpreted by a nearby floor assistant as an urgent, non-verbal procurement order for the afternoon break.

'I was simply emphasizing the upward trajectory of our GDP, not demanding a catering emergency for the entire legislative wing,' the chief minister explained to reporters while holding an empty takeaway box. 'It was an entirely inadvertent piece of physical rhetoric, though I must admit the mutton was exceptionally tender and arrived with remarkable speed given the legislative hurdles we usually face.'

Opposition leaders, who had initially accused the administration of 'gourmet bribery,' have since retracted their complaints after being served two plates each. The canteen manager, speaking on condition of anonymity, noted that while the gesture was indeed misinterpreted, the kitchen staff was relieved to finally have a mandate that involved serving food rather than drafting another subcommittee report on legislative seating arrangements.
caption: When you accidentally order a state-wide feast while just trying to explain fiscal policy. 🍛🗳️ #AssemblyDiaries #BiryaniProtocol #PoliticsLife #UnexpectedFeast (satire)
